_comment: CURATED, not generated. `effect` is sent to Jev verbatim — describe what the item does, never when to buy it, or the model is just reading our opinion back. `counters` must come from THREAT_TAGS in src/main/advise/tags.ts. `situational: true` means the item only enters the candidate list when a matching enemy tag is present (plan M4).

item_black_king_bar.effect: grants immunity to most spells and disables for a few seconds, on a cooldown that shortens with use

item_dust.effect: reveals nearby invisible heroes for a short time and slows them

item_ward_sentry.effect: a stationary ward that reveals invisible units in a small area

item_gem.effect: permanently reveals invisible units around the carrier, but drops on death

item_sphere.effect: blocks one targeted enemy spell entirely, then recharges after a delay

item_glimmer_cape.effect: turns an ally invisible and gives them a large amount of magic resistance

item_pipe.effect: gives the team a barrier that absorbs magic damage, and grants magic resistance

item_cloak.effect: a cheap item granting flat magic resistance

item_lotus_orb.effect: removes debuffs from an ally and reflects targeted enemy spells back at their caster

item_aeon_disk.effect: automatically removes debuffs and makes the carrier briefly immune when they drop to low health

item_ghost.effect: makes the carrier untargetable by attacks while taking extra magic damage

item_crimson_guard.effect: gives the team a shield that blocks a portion of every incoming attack

item_blade_mail.effect: returns a share of the damage the carrier takes back to whoever dealt it

item_heavens_halberd.effect: disarms one enemy so they cannot attack for several seconds, and grants evasion

item_force_staff.effect: pushes the carrier or an ally a fixed distance forward, instantly

item_cyclone.effect: lifts a hero into the air, removing debuffs from an ally or interrupting an enemy

item_wind_waker.effect: lifts a hero into the air and lets the carrier steer themselves while airborne, removing debuffs

item_spirit_vessel.effect: heavily reduces an enemy's healing and burns their health over time

item_shivas_guard.effect: reduces enemy attack speed nearby and cuts healing in a large blast

item_orchid.effect: silences one enemy for several seconds and amplifies the damage they take while silenced

item_bloodthorn.effect: silences one enemy, reveals them, and makes every attack against them a guaranteed critical hit

item_sheepstick.effect: turns an enemy into a harmless animal, stopping all abilities and items for several seconds

item_abyssal_blade.effect: stuns one enemy through magic immunity and chains stuns from attacks

item_nullifier.effect: dispels an enemy, stopping invisibility and blink escapes, and slows them heavily

item_silver_edge.effect: grants invisibility and a strike that disables the target's passive abilities

item_monkey_king_bar.effect: attacks cannot miss and deal extra damage on hit

item_mjollnir.effect: chain lightning on attacks and a shield that shocks attackers, clearing groups of weak units

item_bfury.effect: attacks splash damage onto nearby units, and gives strong farming sustain

item_radiance.effect: burns nearby enemies over time and makes them miss attacks

item_manta.effect: creates two illusions and removes most debuffs from the carrier on use

item_satanic.effect: converts a large share of attack damage into health and removes debuffs when activated

item_heart.effect: a very large pool of health with strong out-of-combat regeneration

item_assault.effect: attack speed for the team and armour reduction for nearby enemies

item_solar_crest.effect: strips armour and accuracy from an enemy, or adds them to an ally

item_hurricane_pike.effect: pushes the carrier and a target apart, then lets them attack from long range for a few shots

item_eternal_shroud.effect: converts magic damage taken into mana and grants magic resistance with a spell barrier

item_guardian_greaves.effect: heals the team, restores mana, and removes most debuffs from everyone nearby

item_mekansm.effect: instantly heals every nearby ally and grants armour

item_vladmir.effect: an aura granting lifesteal, armour, mana regeneration and damage to the whole team

item_diffusal_blade.effect: burns mana on every attack and applies a strong slow that also dispels

item_ethereal_blade.effect: makes a target immune to attacks but take much more magic damage, and bursts them

item_veil_of_discord.effect: increases the magic damage every enemy in an area takes

item_smoke_of_deceit.effect: hides the team from enemy vision and wards until they get close to a hero

item_blink.effect: teleports the carrier a short distance instantly, on a cooldown that resets out of combat

item_tpscroll.effect: teleports the carrier to a friendly structure after a short channel

item_kaya.effect: increases spell damage and cuts the mana cost of abilities

item_yasha.effect: adds attack speed and movement speed

item_yasha_and_kaya.effect: adds spell damage, cheaper abilities, attack speed and movement speed together

item_kaya_and_sange.effect: adds spell damage, cheaper abilities, and resistance to disables and damage

item_sange_and_yasha.effect: adds attack speed, movement speed, health, and resistance to disables

item_sange.effect: adds health and resistance to disables and slows

item_octarine_core.effect: shortens every ability cooldown and heals the carrier from the spell damage they deal

item_ultimate_scepter.effect: upgrades the hero's ultimate ability, often changing what it can do entirely

item_aether_lens.effect: extends the range abilities can be cast from, and adds mana and regeneration

item_refresher.effect: resets the cooldowns of every ability and item once, allowing a second full set of spells

item_arcane_boots.effect: restores mana to the carrier and every nearby ally

item_phase_boots.effect: adds attack damage and a burst of movement speed that passes through units

item_power_treads.effect: adds attack speed and can be switched between attributes for mana or health

item_travel_boots.effect: teleports to any friendly unit and gives the highest movement speed

item_dragon_lance.effect: extends attack range and adds attack speed for a ranged hero

item_desolator.effect: strips armour from whatever the carrier attacks and adds heavy attack damage

item_maelstrom.effect: chains lightning off attacks, clearing creeps and speeding up farm

item_greater_crit.effect: adds a large critical strike and heavy attack damage

item_butterfly.effect: adds high attack speed, damage, and evasion against attacks

item_skadi.effect: adds a large health and mana pool and slows whatever the carrier attacks while cutting its healing

item_echo_sabre.effect: adds two quick attacks that slow the target, plus mana regeneration

item_harpoon.effect: pulls the carrier to a fleeing target and adds attack speed and damage

item_helm_of_the_dominator.effect: takes control of a neutral creep and gives the team lifesteal

item_meteor_hammer.effect: channels a falling meteor that stuns and burns an area, and damages structures

item_aghanims_shard.effect: grants an extra ability or upgrades an existing one
